test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven friends - Asha, Sreeja, Mamata, Ramya, Hema, Jaya, and Mohini - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Ramya is sitting fourth to the right of Asha. Mamata sits third to the left of Ramya. Jaya has Sreeja and Mamata as immediate neighbours. Hema is sitting to the immediate right of Ramya.

Who is sitting second to the left of Mohini?
solution: **Given: **Seven friends - Asha, Sreeja, Mamata, Ramya, Hema, Jaya, and Mohini - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Ramya is sitting fourth to the right of Asha. Mamata sits third to the left of Ramya.
